name: MBYTECHNOLOGY
notes:
We operate as an ISP with a primary presence in London.

Upstream connectivity is provided via transit providers.
We maintain settlement-free peering at IXPs and via route-servers.

Peering policy:
- Open to settlement-free peering
- IPv6 preferred (IPv4 available where applicable)
- No transit over peering
- No third-party traffic via IXP

Traffic engineering is done using standard BGP attributes.

For peering requests, please contact our NOC.
